comments.body: **Undefined AWS helper blocks loading** The AWS extraction removes the local `_aws` definition without importing it, but the retained `_AWS_SYNC = _aws(...)` assignment still executes at line 44. Importing the command catalog therefore raises `NameError`, preventing the daemon and hook command modules from loading. Remove the stale AWS constants and assignment now that `command_storage_aws_s3.py` owns those rules.

Addressed in `f8bae764`. Removed the stale `_AWS_SYNC = _aws(...)` assignment. The storage module now imports the AWS rules/specs from `command_storage_aws_s3` and includes them in the aggregate catalog; it has no `_aws` reference. [Published source](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/f8bae76423f8120cb7c496f57407f7d47945f73d/src/codex_plugin_scanner/guard/runtime/command_storage_extensions.py#L7).

**Duplicate function breaks dashboard build** The merge leaves two identical module-level implementations of `focusVisibleDashboardSearch`, at lines 118 and 130. These duplicate declarations prevent `vite build` from building the dashboard. Keep one implementation alongside the new dashboard-location navigation helper.

Addressed in `f8bae764`. Kept one `focusVisibleDashboardSearch` implementation alongside the dashboard navigation helper. [Published source](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/f8bae76423f8120cb7c496f57407f7d47945f73d/dashboard/src/app.tsx#L118). The [dashboard CI job](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35377269052/job/105704788672) for this PR head passed Vite production build and four browser checks on merge `975967f4`.

**Missing provider import prevents mounting** The `PresentationModeProvider` import was removed, but the root render still uses `` at line 19. After the duplicate declaration is fixed, this entry point will throw `ReferenceError` before the dashboard mounts. Restore the import so the retained presentation-mode consumers remain connected to their provider. ```suggestion import { App } from "./app"; import { PresentationModeProvider } from "./presentation-mode-provider"; import "./tailwind-root.css"; ```

Addressed in `f8bae764`. Restored the `PresentationModeProvider` import; the root render still wraps `App` with that provider. [Published source](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/f8bae76423f8120cb7c496f57407f7d47945f73d/dashboard/src/main.tsx#L5). The [dashboard CI job](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35377269052/job/105704788672) for this PR head passed Vite production build and four browser checks on merge `975967f4`.

**Common CLI extensions are dropped** Replacing the common-CLI catalog entry with repo2nb drops the release branch’s non-core extensions, including Vault and Cloudflare, from the built-in registry. The remaining `_core_values` inclusion does not preserve them: `command_extension_values` filters rules by the current extension ID, discarding those non-core prefixes. Their catalog entries, permissions, and command-specific rules therefore disappear. Include both catalogs rather than replacing the common-CLI entry. ```suggestion (REPO2NB_COMMAND_EXTENSION_SPECS, REPO2NB_COMMAND_RULES), (COMMON_CLI_COMMAND_EXTENSION_SPECS, COMMON_CLI_COMMAND_RULES), ```

Addressed in `f8bae764`. The direct extension catalogs now include both Common CLI and repo2nb. Their rule tuples remain additive, so the repo2nb addition no longer replaces Vault/Cloudflare and the other Common CLI entries. [Published source](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/f8bae76423f8120cb7c496f57407f7d47945f73d/src/codex_plugin_scanner/guard/runtime/command_builtin_extension_catalog.py#L52).

**Everyday approval explanations disappear** The query changes remove live explanation attachment from both queue pages and individual requests, while the retained Everyday-mode UI still requires `action_explanation` for its previews. Requests now show “Plain-language details are unavailable” instead of the action summaries previously produced by the release branch. Restore explanation attachment across the read paths and keep its identity contract compatible with the retained frontend validator. **Knowledge Base Used:** [Dashboard product workspaces](https://app.greptile.com/hol/-/custom-context/knowledge-base/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/-/docs/dashboard-product-workspaces.md)

Addressed in `f8bae764`. Restored live explanation attachment for list, pending-summary, paginated, single-request, and next-pending reads. Summary projections retrieve the persisted action identity/envelope; Python and the retained frontend use the same domain-separated `act_` identity contract. Exact technical details remain withheld by default. [Published source](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/f8bae76423f8120cb7c496f57407f7d47945f73d/src/codex_plugin_scanner/guard/store_approval_queries.py#L83).

**Publisher exceeds file-size limit** The new snapshot publisher is 503 lines long, violating the repository directive that all files must be 500 lines or fewer. Move a cohesive responsibility into an existing supporting module or otherwise reduce the file to the required size. This repository requirement must be satisfied before merging. **Rule Used:** All files should be 500 lines or less. Files more than this size need to be optimized. ([source](https://app.greptile.com/hol/-/custom-context?memory=b1fb4058-16b0-4a08-b802-215714564774)) Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!

Addressed in `f8bae764`. Extracted publication context resolution and verifier-key provisioning into `native_policy_snapshot_publisher_context.py`. The publisher is now 483 physical / 450 nonblank lines, and the extracted helper is 95 physical / 85 nonblank lines. [Published source](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/f8bae76423f8120cb7c496f57407f7d47945f73d/src/codex_plugin_scanner/guard/native_policy_snapshot_publisher.py#L24).

2\. Daemon server outgrows the file limit 📘 Rule violation ⚙ Maintainability 
server.py contains 8,355 non-blank lines after the changed daemon import at line 44. Any further
server maintenance must navigate a source module more than sixteen times the permitted size.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The changed daemon server module contains 8,355 non-blank lines, exceeding the 500-line source-file limit. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/codex_plugin_scanner/guard/daemon/server.py[44-45] ## Recommended Fix Extract cohesive routing, request handling, and service-lifecycle responsibilities into focused modules containing no more than 500 non-blank lines each. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools

3\. Runtime runner outgrows the file limit 📘 Rule violation ⚙ Maintainability 
runner.py contains 6,002 non-blank lines after the secret-reference pattern is modified at line
822. Changes to runtime execution therefore continue accumulating in a module twelve times the
permitted size.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The changed runtime runner contains 6,002 non-blank lines, exceeding the 500-line source-file limit. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/codex_plugin_scanner/guard/runtime/runner.py[821-824] ## Recommended Fix Extract cohesive execution, matching, and result-processing responsibilities into focused modules containing no more than 500 non-blank lines each. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools

4\. Daemon manager outgrows the file limit 📘 Rule violation ⚙ Maintainability 
manager.py contains 2,841 non-blank lines after the frozen-runtime import is added at line 31.
Daemon orchestration remains concentrated in a source module more than five times the permitted
size.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The changed daemon manager contains 2,841 non-blank lines, exceeding the 500-line source-file limit. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/codex_plugin_scanner/guard/daemon/manager.py[31-34] ## Recommended Fix Extract lifecycle, process-management, and runtime-integration responsibilities into focused modules containing no more than 500 non-blank lines each. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools

5\. Main guard tests outgrow the limit 📘 Rule violation ⚙ Maintainability 
test_guard_cli.py contains 9,050 non-blank lines after the network helper import is added at line
51. Additional command-line test coverage is placed in a test source module eighteen times the
permitted size.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The changed command-line test module contains 9,050 non-blank lines, exceeding the 500-line source-file limit. ## Fix Focus Areas - tests/test_guard_cli.py[48-51] ## Recommended Fix Partition the tests by command or behavior into focused test modules containing no more than 500 non-blank lines each. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools

6\. Approval tests outgrow the file limit 📘 Rule violation ⚙ Maintainability 
test_guard_approvals.py contains 3,638 non-blank lines after the approval lookup and assertion are
added around line 141. Approval behavior remains covered through a test source module more than
seven times the permitted size.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The changed approval test module contains 3,638 non-blank lines, exceeding the 500-line source-file limit. ## Fix Focus Areas - tests/test_guard_approvals.py[138-141] ## Recommended Fix Partition approval tests by lifecycle or behavior into focused modules containing no more than 500 non-blank lines each. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools

7\. Approval gate tests outgrow the limit 📘 Rule violation ⚙ Maintainability 
test_guard_approval_gate.py contains 1,890 non-blank lines after the network helper import is
added at line 58. Gate scenarios remain concentrated in a test source module almost four times the
permitted size.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The changed approval-gate test module contains 1,890 non-blank lines, exceeding the 500-line source-file limit. ## Fix Focus Areas - tests/test_guard_approval_gate.py[55-58] ## Recommended Fix Partition gate tests by scenario into focused modules containing no more than 500 non-blank lines each. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools

8\. Home dashboard outgrows the file limit 📘 Rule violation ⚙ Maintainability 
home-dashboard.tsx contains 1,056 non-blank lines after the runtime-error-copy import is added at
line 37. Dashboard presentation and behavior remain coupled in a component source more than twice
the permitted size.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The changed home dashboard contains 1,056 non-blank lines, exceeding the 500-line source-file limit. ## Fix Focus Areas - dashboard/src/home-dashboard.tsx[34-37] ## Recommended Fix Extract cohesive dashboard sections and supporting logic into focused modules containing no more than 500 non-blank lines each. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools

9\. Application shell outgrows the file limit 📘 Rule violation ⚙ Maintainability 
app.tsx contains 1,001 non-blank lines after the dashboard-session import is added at line 25.
Application routing and shell behavior remain concentrated in a component source twice the permitted
size.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The changed application shell contains 1,001 non-blank lines, exceeding the 500-line source-file limit. ## Fix Focus Areas - dashboard/src/app.tsx[22-25] ## Recommended Fix Extract routing, session, and shell sections into focused modules containing no more than 500 non-blank lines each. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools

10\. Runtime actions outgrow the file limit 📘 Rule violation ⚙ Maintainability 
actions.py contains 1,016 non-blank lines after the Hermes hook import is added at line 16.
Runtime action responsibilities remain in a source module more than twice the permitted size.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The changed runtime actions module contains 1,016 non-blank lines, exceeding the 500-line source-file limit. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/codex_plugin_scanner/guard/runtime/actions.py[13-16] ## Recommended Fix Extract action families and adapter integrations into focused modules containing no more than 500 non-blank lines each. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools

11\. Hook runner outgrows the file limit 📘 Rule violation ⚙ Maintainability 
hook_process_runner.py contains 561 non-blank lines after the process-creation import is added at
line 11. The changed runner remains above the limit even though splitting a single focused
responsibility would bring it into compliance.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The changed hook process runner contains 561 non-blank lines, exceeding the 500-line source-file limit. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/codex_plugin_scanner/guard/daemon/hook_process_runner.py[8-11] ## Recommended Fix Extract one cohesive process-running responsibility into a supporting module so every resulting source file has no more than 500 non-blank lines. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools

12\. Error parsing nests conditional logic 📘 Rule violation ⚙ Maintainability 
The error normalization expression in runGuardCloudConnect selects record.message and then
evaluates another ternary for record.error in its else branch. Responses lacking a string message
traverse this chained expression before receiving an error description.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description Cloud-connect error normalization uses a chained ternary whose else branch contains another conditional expression. ## Fix Focus Areas - dashboard/src/guard-cloud-connect-flow.ts[71-74] ## Recommended Fix Replace the chained expression with explicit if statements that assign the message for each response shape. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools

13\. Primary fleet action nests conditions 📘 Rule violation ⚙ Maintainability
